title: Samsung and SK join OpenAI’s Stargate initiative to advance global AI infrastructure
summary: Samsung and SK join OpenAI’s Stargate initiative to expand global AI infrastructure, scaling advanced memory chip production and building next-gen data centers in Korea.
body: Samsung and SK join OpenAI’s Stargate initiative to expand global AI infrastructure, scaling advanced memory chip production and building next-gen data centers in Korea.
summaryZh: 韩国三星与SK正式加入OpenAI的Stargate全球AI基础设施计划。此项合作旨在扩大全球AI底层硬件规模，重点在韩国提升先进存储芯片的产能，并共同建设下一代高性能人工智能数据中心。原始信息显示：Samsung and SK join OpenAI’s Stargate initiative to expand global AI infrastructure, scaling advanced memory chip production and building next-gen data centers in Korea.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“Samsung and SK join OpenAI’s Stargate initiative to advance global AI infrastructure”。其重要性主要体现在：三星与SK加入OpenAI的Stargate基础设施计划，反映了全球AI硬件与数据中心合作的深化。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
